subject: Genetics
title: Test Crosses
description: A quick, practical guide to Test Crosses.

hook.text: A tall pea plant could be TT or Tt. Both look the same. How do you tell? Cross it with a short plant (tt).

buildup.text: If the tall plant is TT, all offspring will be Tt—all tall. If it's Tt, half will be Tt and half tt—some short.

discovery.text: This is a test cross: mating with a homozygous recessive to reveal the unknown parent's hidden alleles.

twist.text: Breeders still use test crosses today. Dog breeders test for hidden disease alleles before breeding expensive lines.

climax.text: DNA testing now replaces physical test crosses. One cheek swab reveals every allele. Faster, cheaper, more precise.

punchline.text: Cross with recessive. Watch the offspring. Read the answer.
